ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface with a high contrast ratio against sparse, high-intensity (white) focal points, estimated at roughly 95:5.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-pixel field covering >90% of the visible area. Numerous high-contrast white focal spots and ring-like clusters are distributed across both lobes, with higher densities observed on the distal margins of the left lobe and the central-lower portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees and a significant depth penetration of roughly 1/4 the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern consisting of sharp triangular peaks and deep valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels) occurring along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex parabolic curve fitting the distal sweep from the median notch to the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple roughly circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters (ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter) distributed across the ventral surface, consistent with barnacle scar morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (light grey on black) visible on the medial-right lobe surface, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both lobes; the distal tip of the right lobe exhibits a slightly more irregular, truncated pixel boundary compared to the more pointed left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique distribution of hollow, ring-shaped white markers against the dark pigment, particularly a clustered group on the left distal margin.
